name: open-weight-agent-stack
description: Build tooling for the Open-Weight Agent Stack manual: diagram rendering and site assets.

scripts.sbom:check: python3 scripts/sbom.py check && node scripts/validate_sbom_schema.cjs --sbom sbom.cdx.json
scripts.test: python3 scripts/test_claim_contracts.py && python3 scripts/test_memory_catalogue.py && python3 scripts/test_readme_hero.py && python3 scripts/test_render_security.py && python3 scripts/test_site_links.py && python3 scripts/test_watch_upstream.py && python3 scripts/test_sbom.py && python3 scripts/test_coverage_gate.py && python3 scripts/test_security_workflows.py && python3 scripts/test_release_metadata.py && python3 scripts/coverage_gate.py && echo 'Offline tests and Python coverage passed. scripts.browser:check: npm run browser:check:normal && npm run browser:check:failure
